name: Theodoros of Melanthos
source:
A withdrawn young man who endeavors to avoid conflict and dislikes attention, rarely speaking his true feelings. Of all the class, he has the closest relationship to the Order, with his father Linos being a current member of the Discretionary Council. Accordingly, many in the arcane healing community expect much from him; expectations he could frankly do without. He is a childhood friend of Utsushikome, though their contemporary relationship is extremely distant. While no ace in terms of exams and casting fundamentals, he has a certain foresight - easily mistaken for neurosis - that leads him to excel when it comes to constructing experiments and, allegedly, during duels. Perhaps these same instincts explain his demeanor. What child doesn't know the story of Cassandra?

[From in-game encyclopedia]
